recipes.name: Black Beans, Corn, and Yellow Rice
ingredients_raw: 1 (15.25 ounce) can whole kernel corn, drained
1 (15 ounce) can black beans, rinsed and drained

steps.text: Bring water, rice, and olive oil to a boil in a saucepan over high heat. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until rice tender, and liquid absorbed, 20 to 25 minutes.
Combine corn, black beans, lime juice, and cumin in a large bowl; stir in rice and serve.

raw_recipe.headline: Black Beans, Corn, and Yellow Rice
raw_recipe.description: Make a meal out of a package of yellow rice by adding black beans, corn, and lime juice.

review.reviewBody: Simple! Tasty! Throw some cilantro in there, man... don't be afraid. Yeah, and some tomato too. That's going to put this through the roof. Add a little funky to it! Don't forget to cumin up that rice, give it that zingy zang!

This is a great recipe! As others have mentioned it is very versatile. It would make a nice side dish or great burrito fillings (we used it for burritos topped with shredded cheese and sour cream). I make my own yellow rice (1 1/2 cups rice, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp onion flakes, 1/2 tsp garlic powder) I put all ingredients both the recipe and my rice recipe in the rice cooker and it came out perfect! My 9yr old LOVED it. I agree with others that some fresh cilantro would dress it up; however, I made it as is and it was great. This is also a PERFECT pantry/emergency dish since everything is shelf stable.

I turned this into a crock pot recipe. My pot allows me to sautee as well so I browned 4 chicken thighs. Remove them when the skin was crisp and reserved.Then threw in a handful of cherry tomatoes sauteed in the chicken fat cooked them until they popped. Then I added the fresh corn that was cut from the cob (3 ears) sauteed for a few minutes then added the can of black beans. Seasoned all with cumin added yellow rice and water put chicken back on top and put on low heat.

I added sauté onions cooked in olive oil with garlic. Then 1 teaspoon of cilantro, cumin, oregano, and can of fire roasted tomatoes. I cooked brown rice in chicken broth. served with grilled lime pork chops

This is a good basic recipe. I usually follow the recipe to the letter when I make it for the first time. After reading the reviews, and considering my own instincts, I felt it needed something more. I made the rice according to package directions (I can't imagine anything other than crunchy rice otherwise!), sautéed a stalk of celery (next time will use two), added two sliced green onions (will add two more next time), added two cloves of minced garlic, double the amount of cumin and lime juice. I also added about of half cup of chopped cilantro (next time will add a full cup). The corn I had on hand included diced poblano peppers and red bell pepper. Next time (how many times have I said "next time"? What does that tell you?) I'll add fresh poblano and red bell pepper. I see this as a great side dish with chicken, as a stuffing for peppers or, as my husband recommended, a filling for omelets. The only reason the recipe didn't get five stars is because I had to tinker with it. For me, a five star rating means the dish is perfection as presented. I think the rice would have been a little too bland for me as written...however the possibilities are endless! Habanero pepper? Serrano pepper? thinly sliced pork? Ground beef mixed in? Vegetarian tacos? Next time....

It is really good, but it is spectacular with some "frills" added. I used a can of petite diced tomatoes, a can of chopped green chilis, more generous amount of cumin and a good amount of chili powder according to your heat tolerance. Of course the lime juice (generously)

It is a great vegetarian dish, but I decided I wanted more of a main dish meal rather than a side. I cooked a pound of crumbled ground beef with onions and cumin and added that. I cooked it all together a short time to get it hot and meld flavors. It was spectacular as I said.

Soooo yummy!!! One of the top three recipes my family loves. I did change a few things but didn't deviate to much from the recipe. I used a rice cooker instead of my stove top, and used chicken stock or broth instead of water. I added about a tsp. More of lime juice, a half tsp. more of cumin. Instead of regular canned corn I used the fiesta corn for a tad bit more flavor. Don't forget the cilantro, it brings everything together.
Definitely will continue to make this.

This was great! Super easy and tasty- perfect for a weeknight meal. I used about 2 cups chicken broth and about a 1/2c water and also added cilantro at the end. I then layered sour cream and cheese in a quesadilla and rolled it with the rice to eat. My 2 and 4 year gobbled this up with no complaints! I'll definitely make again!

Slight changes but it was great. Used mahatma spicy saffron yellow rice and made it according to the package, and I didn't have any canned corn so I used frozen. Added diced onion, tomato, and some chopped cilantro. Then topped it with some grated cojita cheese, it was delicious!

This was good. I sauteed onion and garlic then added rice mix.Next time I will make my own yellow rice and add a can of rotels. Or will make browned beef with taco seasoning and rotels and throw in crockpot on low for the day.

I added a little saute onion and peppers, and used chicken broth with cooking the rice. This is pretty much how I put this togetther when I served it with other mexican food. I like to use frozen corn instead of canned.
Kind of nondescript but filling and nutritious. I’d make it again for that reason.
First time having this. Loved it❣️
Easy and yummy! I used Zatarain's Yellow Rice Mix - prepared as directed on pkg, (instead of the suggested amounts of water & oil) and then added the other ingredients. Great side dish!
Kids liked it fine at first, but when I gave them the option to scoop it up with tortilla chips, it disappeared!!

I need this with brown rice instead of yellow rice and it was just OK.

I did not care for this. I will never make again
Great go to side dish or main dish! Easy and you can customize any way you like! Will make again.
